bottlenecks.title: PR Review Concentration
bottlenecks.description: Sarah Chen approved 75.0% of all PRs last month
bottlenecks.impact: Team velocity is at risk if this person is unavailable. 12 PRs are currently waiting for their review.
bottlenecks.recommendation: Train 2 more developers on code review best practices and distribute review load

bottlenecks.title: Flaky CI/CD Pipeline
bottlenecks.description: 'integration-test' stage fails 44 times (45.8% failure rate)
bottlenecks.impact: Developers waste time re-running builds and lose trust in the pipeline
bottlenecks.recommendation: Investigate and fix flaky tests in integration-test, consider quarantining unstable tests

bottlenecks.title: Excessive Meeting Time
bottlenecks.description: Team spent 41.0% of time in meetings (healthy target: <20%)
bottlenecks.impact: Reduced focus time for deep work. Weekly meeting hours: 137.9
bottlenecks.recommendation: Audit recurring meetings, implement 'No Meeting Wednesdays', and default to async communication

bottlenecks.title: Deploy Queue Bottleneck
bottlenecks.description: Average time from PR-approved to deployed: 10.1 hours (industry avg: 2 hours)
bottlenecks.impact: Features sit idle waiting for deployment, slowing time-to-market
bottlenecks.recommendation: Automate deploy pipeline to run immediately after approval, not on a schedule

bottlenecks.title: Knowledge Silo: Auth
bottlenecks.description: Only 2 people have touched auth code in the last month
bottlenecks.impact: Bus factor of 2 - critical system at risk if these people leave
bottlenecks.recommendation: Schedule knowledge-sharing sessions and pair programming for auth module

bottlenecks.title: Stalled Tickets in Review
bottlenecks.description: 14 tickets blocked waiting for review (avg 4.5 days)
bottlenecks.impact: Sprint velocity impacted, developers context-switching while waiting
bottlenecks.recommendation: Set up daily review rotation and max 24-hour review SLA
